name: DashCore
description: An Android64 performance diagnostics toolkit for Geometry Dash. DashCore measures gameplay update and render costs, inspects the live level scene graph, and compares three object-bounds coordinate interpretations and validates a Bismuth-inspired GLES compute visibility mask. Live render culling remains disabled until off-screen classification is proven correct.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (diagnostic only)
experimental-render-culling.description: Inactive in DashCore 0.7.3. Live object hiding remains disabled while parent-transformed, raw-rectangle, and node-local bounds are compared. The setting is retained for compatibility.
